{{Quote|Storm Squadron is one of the Empire's finest military units, in space or otherwise. They're the very model of the sort of hard-core, dedicated, soldiers that secure the Empire throughout the galaxy.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Landau]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
'''Storm Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], with recruitment based out of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
Known as one of the more elite of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]], Storm Squadron's [[TIE pilot|pilots]] undertook the most dangerous of missions for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Its membership later included pilots recruited from volunteer members of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and Imperial citizens.

Storm Squadron had several [[TIE/Advanced starfighter]]s among the ships at its disposal. The squadron leader's TIE Advanced boasted more damaging lasers and better maneuverability over the regular squadron TIE Advanced, which had greater accuracy. Several of the fighters also had [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launchers]].
